primary_source.citation: Wang X, Wang Z, Pan J, et al. Patterns of Extrathoracic Metastases in Different Histological Types of Lung Cancer. Front Oncol. 2020;10:715.
primary_source.study_type: Population-based SEER analysis; n=159,241 lung cancer patients diagnosed 2010-2014

biomarkers.name: PD-L1 (TPS by 22C3)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Pembrolizumab monotherapy (TPS ≥50%) or chemo-IO regardless of TPS

biomarkers.name: TMB
biomarkers.clinical_use: Associated with immunotherapy benefit, but not a routinely used standalone biomarker in NSCLC clinical decision-making

biomarkers.name: FGFR1 amplification
biomarkers.clinical_use: Investigational; FGFR inhibitor trials, but no established standard-of-care FGFR-targeted therapy in lung SCC

biomarkers.name: PIK3CA mutations
biomarkers.clinical_use: Investigational; no established standard-of-care PI3K-targeted therapy in lung SCC

biomarkers.name: EGFR
biomarkers.prevalence: <5% (uncommon in pure squamous histology; more likely in never-smokers, small biopsies, or mixed histology)
biomarkers.clinical_use: If present, treat with EGFR-directed therapy per NSCLC guidelines

biomarkers.name: NTRK / ALK / ROS1 / BRAF V600E / RET / MET ex14 / KRAS G12C / HER2
biomarkers.clinical_use: Comprehensive molecular testing may be considered in selected advanced-stage squamous cases; actionable alterations are uncommon but can guide matched targeted therapy when identified

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Squamous differentiation with keratinisation, keratin pearls, or intercellular bridges
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Well / moderately / poorly differentiated by degree of keratinisation and pleomorphism

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Often more inflamed than adeno (smoking-driven TMB); mixed 'inflamed' and 'excluded'
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Desmoplastic; central necrosis in large tumours

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Basal cells of bronchial epithelium (proximal airway) — squamous metaplasia of normal columnar epithelium is precursor
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Keratinizing squamous with intercellular bridges and keratin pearls; p40/p63 lineage markers positive
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Field cancerization from smoking produces multifocal disease; central airway location reflects basal cell distribution
